description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - lecture filter: in a class or lecture with uneven information density, declare signal words first (key points / exam / homework / deadline / must-test / review), then listen; only a transcript segment that hits a signal word lights a banner with one TTS call and is stored as a lesson note (sentence + minute marker), while every non-hit segment only moves the heard counter and is discarded immediately - no full transcript is ever stored. No speaker identification, no persistence: all session data lives in memory only and is wiped when the summary is confirmed or the agent closes.
name: lecture-filter
